overview.en:
Search conversations, read messages and communicate through Google’s official Chat API with your Google account.

Bring messages and collaboration context into a focused work brief. Specify the team, conversation, or project and prepare responses from the information actually returned.

Select Connect in the plugin details. One Google account connection is shared by every installed Google plugin; granted permissions still limit each service.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Chat API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索会话、阅读消息与沟通协作。

把消息与协作上下文整理成聚焦的工作简报。明确团队、会话或项目，并依据实际返回的信息准备回复。

在插件详情中选择“连接”。所有已安装的 Google 插件共用一次 Google 账号连接，各服务仍受已授予权限的限制。

starterPrompts.en: Find the recent discussion about this project and summarize its decisions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的近期讨论，汇总已作出的决策。

starterPrompts.en: List the open questions and follow-up items from this conversation.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 列出这段会话中的待确认问题与后续事项。

starterPrompts.en: Draft a team update using the available conversation context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据可用会话上下文起草团队进度更新。

descriptions.en: Use Google Chat in Ghast. Search conversations, read messages and communicate through Google’s official Chat API with your Google account. 通过 Google 官方 Chat API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索会话、阅读消息与沟通协作。
